text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. An 800 words study plan*2. Undergraduate applicants need provide two recommendation letters from their teachers.*3. Physical Examination Form*4. Photocopy of valid passport*5. Most recent ID photo*6. Transcripts of previous academic record.Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.*7. Photocopies of the highest diploma, graduation certificate or diploma certificate attained.University students or employed applicants should provide proof of study or employment. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must have notarized translations in Chinese or English.*8. English proficiency certificate
